issues.title: Export to CSV improvements
issues.body:
The first version is out there, in `handleExport`.

I've spotted some issues, and scientists have made some requests:
- [x] provide tooltip to button
- [x] remove duplicate xlsx in generated filename
- [x] filename should use game-date at time of export, not current time
- [x] some composite objects are being presented as `"[object Object]"`.  These need to be spotted in the XLSX, and unpacked at the parse stage
- [ ] move the game forward through a few turns and re-do export, so scientists can consider changing values of things like health
